description: Lists the codes one hospital reports on its latest (or a given) revision, as list_codes does, each with that hospital's own all-terms sample counts. Paginated; supports query, sort and code_type like list_codes. Backed by the hospital-prices serving snapshot; fails with UNAVAILABLE until the server has opened one.

code_type.description: Code system to list, e.g. CPT. Required unless query is set; with query it may be left empty to search across code types (CodeSummary.code_type tells the hits apart).

page_token.description: Opaque next_page_token from a previous response; only valid with the same request fields.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive search over code prefix and descriptions.

revision_id.description: Optional. A revision_id from list_hospitals. Omit for the latest revision.

name: list_hospital_provider_codes
title: List the codes a hospital charges
